blocks.text: The API should support cursor-based history and a real-time stream. The client merges both into a single ordered list.

blocks.title: API design notes
rows: Deterministic order, gap detection, and replay deduplication

blocks.title: UI-facing API fields
rows: Stable keys for virtualization and diffing
Compatible parsing and explicit feature support
Display and latency telemetry, not canonical ordering

blocks.title: Resume and schema details
items: Cursor or lastSeen for delta fetch.
Event type or priority for filtering.
Locale + device hints for payload shaping.
Schema version and capabilities for compatible rollout.

blocks.text: Snapshot and delta events carry immutable comment IDs, sequence, cursor, and moderation revision. Send-comment accepts a client-generated idempotency key so an uncertain response can reconcile with the echoed event. Removed content is omitted or redacted by the server contract; client hiding is not the security boundary.

blocks.title: From resumable snapshot to visible comment

steps.title: Open
steps.text: Normalize a snapshot and establish the last contiguous cursor.

steps.title: Receive
steps.text: Validate frames, ignore duplicate IDs, detect gaps, and batch store commits.

steps.title: Place
steps.text: Insert at the live edge only in follow mode; otherwise update the pending count.

steps.title: Command
steps.text: Overlay a pending local comment and reconcile it with the authoritative event.
